title: Weighted persistence intensity regression
summary: Persistence diagrams summarize the multiscale topological structure of data, and in applications they often arrive paired with covariates. We develop nonparametric methodology and theory for estimating the expected weighted persistence diagram conditional on a Euclidean covariate. Representing each weighted diagram as a finite random measure on a compact window, we take the density of its conditional expectation as the regression target, the conditional weighted persistence intensity.
